issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

comment.body:
on mobile device i see antiadblock + nuisance you described in your report even with filter in this PR `biosjourney.com,esladvice.com#%#//scriptlet("trusted-replace-node-text", "script", "innerHTML", "(sessionKey) === '1'", "(sessionKey) === '0'")`
-----

### ATTENTION

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

Seemingly it isn't because no matter where I look in the options for your add-on, there's no way for me to actually suppress this floating circle that obnoxiously and intrusively covers up websites all the time. > > I would like to use your browser extension but at this moment I'm struggling to feel like the constant floating circle that appears, obstructing portions of web pages, really justifies the usage of this add-on in any way, shape, or form. There are some great features of this but the one feature that's missing that it absolutely should have is one to hide the little floating browser assistant bubble. It amazes me and astounds me that there is no option whatsoever to hide this floating circle, despite it being such an intrusive and pointless UI element. I say pointless because all of the functionality of that floating circle can be achieved via other areas of the UI that don't require the stupid floating circle in the bottom right-hand corner of the screen. > > I just can't fathom why there is not an option to just hide this stupid annoying little floating circle.
